Disappointing experience and no response from customer support

I’m writing this review in the hope that someone from Woofz will actually see it and get in touch with me.

I signed up for the four-week introductory course and £12 was taken from my account immediately. Unfortunately, I’ve been unable to log into the app, as I keep receiving a technical error message. I’ve also received no confirmation email, and attempts to reset my password have been unsuccessful.

I’ve contacted customer support to explain the situation but haven’t received a response or even an acknowledgement.

It’s a real shame because I was genuinely looking forward to using the app. Instead, I’ve paid for a service I can’t access and have been left with no way of resolving the problem.

Hopefully someone from Woofz will read this and take the time to contact me.

Even when you’ve not used it. They don’t actually care about your experience. They just want to take your money. If they cared, they would add automatic charge and then only people who were really using and interested in the app would want to pay once the trial period ended. It’s just another money making rip off app. Get you hooked in the advertising then charge you after the trial for a ridiculous amount of money even though you didn’t like the app and have never even used it passed the first look. It’s not helpful at all.

reviews.title: AVOID AT ALL COST!
reviews.text: AVOID AT ALL COST! Like many others reviewing here I’ve had payments taken from my bank account without this company informing me of the ongoing subscription, cost or that payments are being taken. All very sneaky! I literally had no idea they’d signed me up to their ongoing subscription, never heard from them once and I had no email asking if I wanted to continue after the free trial period. Literally nothing! You go onto the app, try the free trial and then it quietly charges you a fortune. Just under £300 a year for an app? Totally ridiculous! This is a total scam!

reviews.title: This App is ALL about Misleading Payment
reviews.text:
I signed up for what appeared to be a 7-day introductory offer, but the payment and subscription process was not clear enough. I was later charged for access, and there was also a PDF training plan purchase that I still do not clearly understand where or how I purchased. Thanks to my bank think there are suspicious activities so they blocked my account. 
 
Although the support team replied and refunded part of the charges, the overall experience was confusing. The website should make the payment flow, subscription renewal terms, and additional purchases much clearer before customers complete payment.
I think the payment process was misleading and should be improved to avoid similar confusion for other customers.

reviews.title: AI Operated Thieves
reviews.text: The company has no idea how to maintain accounts. I purchased a subscription through Apple, canceled it, but they continued to charge me for two months after cancellation. After contacting them they only responded in either copy/paste templates and AI generated responses. The responses had inhuman response times, verbiage that didn’t make any sense, and no ability to comprehend the messages I was sending. They mentioned screenshots I added to the email, but I didn’t add an attachment. They noted that my profile wasn’t fully setup, but when I go into the app I have a full profile with history of use. It was obvious I was either talking to an AI email responder or someone who was only copy/pasting templates and filling in my information and not paying attention to what I was actually saying. Guess my only move now is to give my bank the evidence and seek reimbursement through them.

reviews.title: SCAM!!!!
reviews.text: I downloaded the app to see if it had some tips to help me with my new puppy and then i started getting fraudulent notifications from woofz, with many random charges!!! I did not authorize any payments nor did I ever sign up for a subscription. They have tried to get 3 payments out of me, luckily 2 out of the 3 were declined because i turned my card off. First time was for $6 and it went through, second time was for $38 and so I reported it and canceled my so called “subscription” and then next day they tried to again me for $23!!! Note: I never even used the app, I only created an account and didn’t even get a chance to look around and yet it still tried to scam me!

reviews.title: expensive
reviews.text: random fees and expensive, taken almost £40 out of my account after i paid for a week trial and left me short, would probably be better if they auto cancelled after the trial and let their customers decide if they want to renew or not. they refuse refund, i deleted account and app. i checked app store to see if there was any unwanted subscriptions and it didnt even show up there so i thought i was in the clear, seems like a scam and comes with expensive random fees for services you may not use. wouldnt recommend, painted with ‘professional trainers’ to charge as much as they can.

reviews.title: Feel scammed
reviews.text: I originally signed up for the app and it didn’t work. I didn’t see a charge on my credit card and assumed the purchase hadn’t worked. I tried to troubleshoot and sign in and was prompted to sign up again. At that point, I didn’t the free trial, didn’t think the app was for me (it started at basic puppy training when I needed other fixes for an adopted dog) and so I unsubscribed. I then ended up with a charge on my card the company is now arguing with me about and it looks like they somehow get to keep my money, though I did unsubscribe. I may try to contact the credit card company but I find this exhausting and wish the company would have in good faith refunded my money. Would not recommend the app based on poor customer service, scamming techniques, and it wasn’t helpful for a dog that already had some training.

reviews.title: Had a great time training, but had serious cancellation issues.
reviews.text: I signed up for a subscription with the woofz app that was meant to last only one week, and it was 7 dollars. Yesterday, when checking to confirm that my subscription had ended, It came to my attention that I was charged 40 dollars, and was automatically put on a month long plan that I wasn’t informed of and didn’t approve of whatsoever. When I signed up I was never informed that I would be automatically put on the month long subscription after my week long subscription ended. I won't be using the app for the next month I was charged whatsoever, and I have already cancelled my subscription with the intention I'd only be using the training for 1 week. I am deeply upset that my money was wasted.

reviews.title: Garbage app, scammy company
reviews.text: I signed up for a 7 day trial of the app to test it for me and my puppy. It was annoying and didn’t work, but no big deal, only $7 to test it. Lo and behold, Woofz automatically charged me two additional months unbeknownst to me. I finally noticed after I kept receiving notification alerts to resume training and went in to ask them about this. They claimed that their sign up page shows that the trial will automatically transfer to a full month automatic subscription - but this is deliberately done in 7 point font that is faint and illegible. They also deliver ally don’t send a receipt for your initial trial OR a receipt for the monthly charges. They are a garbage company whose business model is based on deceiving customers.

reviews.title: Mid advertised charging and generic info
reviews.text:
I signed up to a 4 week trial with a specified price but then there is an additional charge.
When you then get into the app it’s the same generic advice you can get on any internet site for free. Not sure why they make you for though the hassle of answering question to tailor your dogs behaviour to then just give such standard info that you can get for free .

reviews.title: Do NOT trust this app
reviews.text: If I could give a zero star I would. The app lead me to believe I paid a one off payment for access to the app. No clear mention of the auto renewal pricing then no confirmation email or reminder that this payment was going to be taken. Customer service refuse a refund which is appalling so unless you want a random £142 taken from your account without warning avoid this app or at least make sure you cancel this sneaky auto renewal subscription right away.

reviews.title: Cancellation Hassle
reviews.text: I did sign up for the trisl to see what it was about. I know I canceled as soon as I signed up (that’s how I make site they are canceled), but noticed months later charges for $109. Yes I know my finances are my responsibility, but I use this card for big purchases and pay it off. Once I noticed I tried to cancel, didn’t even have the app any longer and had no way to get in to cancel. Wrote to them and asked to cancel and get a refund. They offered me a discount instead. I wrote again telling them to cancel, they told me they cancelled it and would refund one month. I am now in the back and forth and am filing disputes. My apple account shows no active or inactive subscriptions, I have been getting many emails for months offering me a discount to sign up…. Now why would they send those, according to them I have a paid subscription. Waste of time, I’m sure the very expensive online services may be great for someone but if you give it a try be prepared to fight to cancel and get your money back. Many online reviews saying the same thing.

reviews.title: Don’t do the free trial you will be stuck paying.
reviews.text: Cannot log in to contact anybody this isn’t under my subscriptions as I have cancelled yet the money has been getting taken out of my bank account. I only signed up to the free trial and looked at it the first night and didn’t log back in again! Now I’m stuck paying just under £40 a month for something I can’t and won’t use!

reviews.title: SCAM ALERT: Charged despite canceling, buyer beware
reviews.text:
I signed up for this, was never able to log into my account, canceled, and emailed for a refund. I was refunded but charged $36 the following month, and Angelina and Nadija in Support refused to provide a refund—for a service I canceled and was never even able to use. I am filing a credit card payment dispute.

The response to this review shows that the app intentionally defrauds people by not fully canceling their account when they ask for a refund and continuing to charge. The developer did not even offer a refund-just to make sure the cancellation was fully processed on their end as they should have done in the first place.

Luckily, my credit card refunded me after the unscrupulous app developers refused to. Their faux apology rings hollow. I would urge others who have been similarly defrauded (there are hundreds in these reviews) to reach out to their credit card companies and to file a complaint with Apple or Google as this company is doing this intentionally and will not reverse the charges.

reviews.title: More wants more
reviews.text:
I was lead to believe that if I payed £12 for this app I would receive the help I needed to train and understand my dog better. 
As soon as I had paid the money the app encouraged me so spend more money on another thing that was crucial to the overall curriculum. 
I fear this app is just like a cheap airline that keep adding fees to the initial enticing price.
I am very disappointed and will not have to work out if I have signed away more than I initially planned to spend. 
Its a real shame because I was really looking forward to using the app and might have been will to part with more money further down the line if I had see results.
I hope that the creators of this app understand dogs better then they understand humans because they made me uneasy by the second or third step of engagement.

reviews.title: Unethical Customer Support
reviews.text:
I canceled my free trial before the cutoff date because the program wasn’t a great fit for my pet. I didn’t receive a confirmation email, but the cancellation appeared to go through successfully, so I had no reason to believe otherwise.

I was later charged. While the charge itself was frustrating, the bigger issue was the experience with customer support afterward. I contacted support immediately to explain the situation, request a refund, and ensure my subscription was fully canceled. What followed was around 20 emails back and forth.

Support initially refused a refund, then offered 30% back (twice), and later said 60% was the “best they could do.”(twice) I continued to decline and explained that I had canceled on time and that the lack of confirmation was either a system or app error, not user error. Only after stating that I would escalate the issue with my bank did they finally agree to issue a full refund. (AFTER APPROX. 20 EMAILS back and forth!😭)

This experience was unnecessarily exhausting and disappointing. The app itself may work well for many dogs, and I truly believe it could be helpful for the right fit , my pet simply has different training needs. However, the customer support and refund process make this hard to recommend unless you are 100% committed to completing the program.

If you cancel or run into issues, be prepared to advocate for yourself. Personally, I would suggest exploring more reputable training programs before supporting an app with such a di

reviews.title: Watch out for scams
reviews.text: It looked very clear we were making a one time purchase to only be charged $100 on a subscription later they say they were clear about and could not refund - we never would have used a subscription and it’s incredibly hard to cancel - there isn’t even that choice in the app - only to pause. You have to physically contact them. Be careful and make sure you know what you’re getting. Shame bc the product is cute but the service is scammy and no consideration for refund. Will be disputing. **updated to note the developers response was not al all my experience. I only used the app and there was no option in the app to cancel provided I had to reach out to them and deal with back and forth via email. There was also no clear understanding it was a subscription when I purchased, in fact quite the opposite.

reviews.title: Should have read the reviews before….
reviews.text: Scam…. Basically what have been said before… paid £12 for a 4 week plan to find out it was a monthly payment of £30 and now I can’t even log in to the app… clearly we shouldn’t call it a scam if it happens once but after reading the reviews for the past year clearly a scam…. 🤔

reviews.title: Cancel your subscription
reviews.text:
It’s not clear that this is a subscription when you download this app so remember to cancel.

It doesn’t take into account the questionnaire you complete so your app starts at the very basic ‘sit’ rather jumping to the areas you’re interested in learning about.

reviews.title: Make sure to read the fine print
reviews.text: While it’s technically true that all the costs are there on the sign up page, make sure you scroll all the way to the bottom and read the itty bitty fine print that should you want to cancel your subscription (that you likely got with a somewhat misleading promotion), and if you don’t do it in a timely  at least 24 hour period before the renewal date, you will automatically, (with no notice) be charged up to a cool $99 a month. A month! For a mediocre app at best. If you’ve got money to burn, sure. Use the app’s guidance and timers for basic dog training. If you’ve got any dog experience at all and are hurting financially like most of us, save your money and frustration and look up tips online and use the built in timer on your phone. Or, at the very least, read every bit of fine print so you’re not surprised in the middle of the night when you see an unexpected and unauthorized charge. I will say their customer service was prompt and replied to all my messages though, in their defense.
